title: run_venture_tests.py <slug> printed ok for a pnpm-workspace venture whose vitest suites it never runs
problem: After the paid bets moved into ventures/ (payapps, jobshop-quote, seller-books, cmmc on 2026-11-27), `run_venture_tests.py payapps` ran only its 10 top-level *.test.mjs in 0.6 s and printed 'ok', while the app's 1,384 vitest unit and 572 worker tests, the site and the packages ran only in payapps-ci.yml.
